title: Akan Gold-Weight Balance
tagline: Measure the gold dust exactly, in the fewest weighings.
description: A brass pan balance, a handful of cast weights and a customer's order. Put weights on both pans, even weigh the bag itself, and serve each order in as few weighings as you can. Hints that teach, a Daily Order and Watch and Learn. Portrait or landscape.
howToPlay: Fill the bag with exactly the amount on the order slip.
Drag weights onto the pans, or tap a weight to send it to a pan.
The dust poured is what the right pan weighs minus the left.
From market day three the bag itself can sit on a pan.
Tap the lamp for a hint: where to look, then why it works.
